title: b7z9.29.1: Define CCP-15 constants across all languages
description: Add RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32, INTERFERENCE_ESCAPE_TENTHS=1000 to Python constants, Rust rf_health.rs constants, and C constant headers. Spec 02a sections 2a.10.3-2a.10.6 define these. Currently absent everywhere. Pure constant additions, no logic.
close_reason: CCP-15 constants defined across all languages per spec 02a 2a.10.3-2a.10.4 (both marked proposed in the spec): RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 (rolling metrics window, 2a.10.3) and INTERFERENCE_ESCAPE_TENTHS=1000 (interference escape threshold, 2a.10.4). (1) Python: python/src/lichen/constants.py gains both ints; (2) Rust canonical: rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs gains pub const RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF: u8 = 32 and pub const INTERFERENCE_ESCAPE_TENTHS: u16 = 1000; (3) C: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/include/lichen/routing/gradient.h gains LICHEN_RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF 32U and LICHEN_INTERFERENCE_ESCAPE_TENTHS 1000U #defines (routing subsystem, adjacent to the adaptive-SF table they gate). Verification: cargo test -p lichen-core 363/363 green, ruff clean, C gradient TU compiles under -Wall -Wextra -Werror with the host test defines. Codereview 1x Kimi K3: PASS except one P2 (my first cut DUPLICATED the constants in rf_health.rs alongside constants.rs — two public paths to the same value, silent-divergence hazard) — fixed by keeping the canonical definitions in constants.rs only (crate convention, reviewer-cited: rf_health.rs already imports CSMA_* from constants). No consumers needed the rf_health paths. No new beads (constant-only change). The P2 and the fix are recorded here.
